description: A classic three-circle Hidden Mickey appears sideways on a dark red fireball element behind one of the Critter Pop-Out animal cutouts in the entrance queue. The beaver figure partially blocks the shape, making this one especially easy to overlook.

whereToLook.scene: Standing Critter Pop-Out display board along the right side of the entrance queue
whereToLook.exactSpot: Behind the beaver cutout on the board surface behind it

bestTip: Shift your position slightly to the left of the board so you can see past the beaver cutout.
funFacts: This Hidden Mickey is intentionally obscured, rewarding guests who slow down and scan the queue details rather than rushing toward the entrance.

viewing.notes: Beaver cutout blocks the shape unless you shift slightly left.
